sentences.text:

Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant and the victim were on talking terms.

It was also stated that the applicant used to harass the victim on telephone since the last eight months and around eight months ago, the applicant had taken her to a hotel, where wrong was committed after administering something in the cold drink.
It was also stated that certain inappropriate photos were taken and the applicant was harassing the victim and was demanding money.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that even as per the FIR, the relationship continued in between them for a span of one year, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 31.05.2024 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ajeet Singh be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 100 of 2024, under Sections 328, 376, 384, 506 IPC and Section 66 of Information Technology Act, Police station Alambagh, District Lucknow, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
